reasoning_steps: Identify the light bulbs and their connections.
Note that touching a light bulb will turn on itself and its adjacent light bulbs.
Determine the minimum number of light bulbs to touch to achieve the goal.
Start by touching one light bulb, which will turn on itself and its adjacent light bulbs.
Continue touching light bulbs until all light bulbs are turned on.
Count the number of light bulbs touched to achieve the goal.
